identity.name: TECHKNOWGREEN SOLUTIONS LIMITE
identity.industry: Environmental Consulting, Air & Water Tech & Climate Research

summary.oneLiner: Revenue grew 40.7% YoY driven by knowledge consulting and R&D, but margins compressed due to Rs. 3cr lab CAPEX; key catalyst is Yuka Yantra commercialization and NABL lab certification in next 2 months, which could unlock government tenders and high-margin revenue streams

one-line thesis: Revenue grew 40.7% YoY driven by knowledge consulting and R&D, but margins compressed due to Rs. 3cr lab CAPEX; key catalyst is Yuka Yantra commercialization and NABL lab certification in next 2 months, which could unlock government tenders and high-margin revenue streams
financial scorecard: revenue: +40.7% YoY (Rs. 32.98cr); EBITDA: -17.8% YoY (31.2% vs 37.97%) due to lab CAPEX; PAT: -10.9% YoY (23.22% vs 26.05%) due to one-off asset investment; order book: Rs. 23cr (Mar '25) + Rs. 15cr pipeline (Apr-Jun '25) = ~Rs. 38cr; net debt: Rs. 7.5cr OD sanctioned but largely unused
guidance: revenue growth: >50% YoY target; margin: EBITDA >30%, PAT >25%; order inflow: Rs. 40cr+ expected by Jun '25; capex/commissioning: NABL lab cert by Aug 2025, Yuka Yantra scaling
order book & pipeline: Rs. 23cr unexecuted as of Mar '25; additional Rs. 15cr in signed pipeline (Apr-Jun '25), total ~Rs. 38cr
segment / subsidiary detail: Knowledge: Rs. 17.83cr (+40.2% YoY), 73% private; Technology: Rs. 6.39cr (+4.9% YoY), 95% private; R&D: Rs. 8.76cr (+89.2% YoY), 67% government; Yuka Yantra: 22-25 units sold, Rs. 10-50L/unit; CEWT: pilot in Ulhasnagar Nallah; Software: beta testing, launch expected Q3FY26
growth verticals / optionality: Global sustainability bids with Sterling & Wilson (Middle East/US); NABL-certified lab for high-margin testing/research; CEWT scaling in municipal wastewater; Know Your Compliance software monetization; US/Singapore subsidiary revenue ramp
margins & cost dynamics: EBITDA down to 31.2% due to Rs. 3cr lab CAPEX (cash outflow); PAT down to 23.2% for same reason; target 30%+ EBITDA, 25%+ PAT; Yuka Yantra gross margin target 30-50%; lab testing margins target 30%+
capex / expansion: Rs. 7.5cr OD sanctioned; Rs. 3cr deployed into TRL9 Climate Lab; additional CAPEX in computers, software, vehicles; no new CAPEX planned beyond lab certification and Yuka Yantra scaling
capital allocation: Prioritizing R&D and CAPEX over dividends; lab and tech commercialization funded from cash; no equity dilution planned; global subsidiaries funded via internal accruals
risks & watch-items: NABL certification delay; slow government tender conversion for Yuka Yantra; software adoption lag; US/Singapore regulatory hurdles; margin pressure from CAPEX
management quality / tone: Highly optimistic, confident in tech commercialization, transparent about margin compression being temporary due to strategic CAPEX, aggressive on global expansion
non-obvious takeaways: Yuka Yantra has IoT-enabled real-time pollution monitoring dashboards; lab is already generating research papers pre-NABL; CEWT uses plastic bottles and grasses — low-cost, scalable wastewater solution; US/Singapore entities are not just subsidiaries but strategic entry points for global ESG consulting
